messages:
paul_t: FYI partner reported intermittent nvml init failures on their custom kernel. They run driver 535.72 and asked for a signed hotpatch or a compat image.

nina_h: Do we have repro? Which CUDA/ROCm combo?

cheng: Repro on Ampere with kernel 5.15 + driver 535.72 + CUDA 12.2.0. Our staging uses 535.86 + CUDA 12.2.1 which passed.

paul_t: Partner prefers hotpatch (less approvals). They need GPG-signed tarball with checksum and rollback steps.

release-bot: Hotpatch CI queued: hotpatch-smoke/1778889999. Tests: driver load/unload, nvml init, basic inference. ETA ~15m.

partner-nre: We can validate tonight but require signed artifact for prod. Also need short runbook for airgapped install.

cheng: Drafted hotpatch bundle (install.sh, modules/, manifest.sha256, README). Uploaded to staging: gs://redwood-staging/hotpatches/1778889999/hotpatch.tar.gz

release-bot: CI completed: 7/7 tests passed. No kernel oops. Artifacts: gs://redwood-staging/logs/hotpatch-1778889999.txt

security: Please provide file for signing and include key fingerprint after sign-off.

paul_t: Ops, can you add gpg verify and sha256 checks to install.sh and include an uninstall helper? Also include nvlink heuristic to bail if link errors present.

cheng: Will update install.sh and repackage. New path once signed.

partner-nre: Confirmed hotpatch smoke in their staging infra. Ready for signed bundle.

security: Signed artifact posted: hotpatch.tar.gz.asc. Signer fingerprint: 9F2A 3C4D 8E0B 1A2C 3D4E 5F67 89AB CDEF 0123 4567. Verification steps in README.

paul_t: Action items:
- cheng: finalize signed tarball with verification + uninstall helper (owner)
- ops: prepare airgap delivery wrapper and storage location (owner)
- nina_h: draft partner bulletin + liability note (owner)
Due: partner requested production deploy by 12:00 UTC tomorrow.

partner-nre: Thanks, we'll schedule deploy and notify SI.

paul_t: Closing thread unless any regressions surface post-deploy.
